WarshipHullUnderlay.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create an animation underlay from this exact approved Russian Classical Age warship.
Remove ONLY ALL TWELVE WORKING WOODEN OARS: six on each side. Remove each working oar from its inner handle through the shaft to its complete outer paddle blade. Do not leave any shaft stub, handle or blade fragment.
Reconstruct only the newly exposed original timber deck, rowing bench surfaces, gunwales and transparent background where the oars were removed. Keep all SIX crosswise rowing benches and their supports. Keep the small fixed gunwale iron brackets/thole attachments. The TWO secured gray iron-tipped spare spears along the forward gunwales are NOT working oars; preserve both entirely. Also preserve both red-brown bow shields and everything else.
Critical invariants: exact same overhead camera, bow-up orientation, hull shape, size, pixel placement and source framing, planking, stern platform, bow deck, iron fasteners, ochre leather panels, light and painted materials. Do NOT recenter, rescale, resize the boat, redesign, add equipment, crew or water. Genuine transparent RGBA canvas. One complete static hull underlay with zero working oars. This underlay will appear only in the small areas exposed by rigid oar animation; it is not a replacement master.
WarshipHullUnderlay.use: Only newly exposed paint beneath the removed original oar masks. Approved master unchanged.
